text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the day of the Asahi Hai F.S., Mejiro Ryan sits in the stands with a solemn look on her face. It seems that her recent loss is still eating away at her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Racked with self-doubt, Mejiro Ryan feels that her performance was unworthy of the Mejiro family name, but Mejiro Bright believes in her potential.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Asahi Hai F.S. marks Ines Fujin's first G1 race. Even though the race is about to start, I can't shake my concerns about the limited prep time we had.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin sees through my awkward attempts to compensate for my concerns, but ends up easing my worries with some words of encouragement of her own. For now, I have to trust in her strength!
